description:
As an operator choosing the system default model, and a person chatting
  I want a change of model to apply to the next answer without a restart,
  and to see which model answered, why, and since when
  So that I can trust the model I chose is the model that served the reply

elements.name: A conversation without an override follows the new default and says so

steps.name: the stub providers "openai", "bdd-provider-b" and "bdd-provider-c" are configured with models "gpt-5.4-mini", "claude-5-sonnet, claude-5-haiku" and "qwen-5-turbo"
the system default model is "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
a conversation "Chat Y" with no model override
5 seconds have passed since the system default was set
I send the message "S1 r2 before"
the reply to "S1 r2 before" came from "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
the answer's receipt names "openai/gpt-5.4-mini" and the origin "system default"
the answer's receipt shows the time the system default became "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
the operator changes the system default to "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
I send the message "S1 r2 after"
the reply to "S1 r2 after" came from "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
the answer's receipt names "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku" and the origin "system default"
the answer's receipt shows the time the system default became "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
the answer's receipt does not show the time the system default became "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
